payload.text: Issue 0711 (vc, 11:33Z, off cc's chain; S, intentsvcs, cc's meaning): migrate.rs's collision guard compares paths byte for byte, so on a case-insensitive disk two attachment paths that differ only in case pass it. The fix is a case-folded key that refuses naming both spellings, proved by a test red on the base and green through the cargo gate on a Desk slot. Ask cc first whether the fold is ASCII or Unicode and whether it refuses on every file system. After issue 0714.
